text: きみ　やさしそう　だから　まける　きが　しない！

structure.jp: きみ　やさしそう　だから
まける　きが　しない！
structure.en: I don't feel like I'll lose!

patterns.name: 〜そうだ
patterns.explanation: そう put on a describing word, in place of its last い, says how something looks. やさしそう = 'looks gentle'.

patterns.name: 〜気がする
patterns.span: まける　きが　しない
patterns.explanation: きが する says you have a feeling that something is so, and きが しない says you don't have that feeling. まける きが しない = 'I don't feel like I'll lose'.

patterns.name: 〜から
patterns.span: やさしそう　だから
patterns.explanation: から after a statement gives the reason for what comes next. やさしそう だから = 'because you look gentle'.
